title: Affine model and factorization data for a component extension
statement: Under the hypotheses of the component extension theorem, there exist a global pointed etale triple c, a compatible map i : c.B → t.B, a ring map b : t.B → V extending η.app c, and a factorization through i for every compatible map β : s.B → t.B.

proof.text: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: Retired in repair X-472ac (head 472ace8c7), E2 review point 4. The existential uniform cancellation assertion is false, not merely its arbitrary-model factorization dependency. Take R = K = V = F_2, p = (0), t the identity local triple and eta the residue-pointing cocone. For any proposed c and i, put C = c.B and take s.B = C × C, diagonal structure, first-coordinate pointing and beta the first projection followed by i. Both compatibility equations hold. Since C is etale over a finite field, C and H = Hom(C,F_2) are finite; i makes H nonempty. The two projection families embed H ⊕ H into Hom(C × C,F_2). Cancellation along any a:C → C × C would inject H ⊕ H into H, contradicting finiteness and nonemptiness. The reviewer supplied a sorry-free product obstruction. The entire theorem and its docstring are deleted, with no replacement; the empty module is retained with linter.privateModule false. The only application site, component_extension_exists, is restored to its unchanged named proof hole.
